title: Build Grave Accord with 66 bosses and ability-changing class upgrades
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord implements 66 distinct boss identities, seven classes, 378 skills/63 paths, 28 weapons, six maps and five modes. This remains unfinished feature-branch development; PR #14 stays draft and main protected.

Candle Snail 1--, Cobble Crab 1- and Mourning Kettle 1 add three original two-phase encounters. Waxwake becomes twin wax rails with a quiet center; Grate Clamp alternates physical closing jaws linked to finite anchor stones; Pressure Pour becomes staggered steam lanes and later crossing beads linked to valves. Shared authority locks warnings, resolves real body and swept hazard collision, preserves clear counterplay props, awards actual hit credit and cleans up every pressure source. Brutal adds a cross-cut, independent extra closure or rear pour alongside real doubled projectile waves. All 63 earlier boss definitions and fixed grades remain unchanged.

Thirty-six selected original motion poses use complete native RGBA ownership, measured foot anchors and one scale per identity. Ten exact built-in ImageGen natives/requests retain the superseded Kettle knot, interrupted-return recovery evidence, faint-alpha bridge ownership and first metadata attempt. Independent Pillow reconstruction verifies native pixels, full atlases and every fallback crop. Loading v5 preserves all prior references and the two-atlas bound. Original Slow Wick, Stones Remember and Tea for the Absent scores have distinct meters/arrangements; all 63 prior masters and score events stay unchanged. All 67 compressed deliveries pass frame/SNR/headroom/DC/seam checks. Fifteen locales have names, two phases, persistent responses and extra-Brutal help.

All latest human difficulty rules remain: Baby 100%, Easy 50%, Normal 25% combat revival; Hard+ disabled through every source. Shield events only Baby/Easy Standard, six/three circles and two/three-second channels, absent from Normal+ and every Brutal. Baby adds two cover props/map, Hard half, Insane/Hellish none. Hellish has warned lava and forces every encounter Brutal. Entry bosses retain two visible phases and Normal health of earlier bosses is unchanged.

The 21 class transformations, default-off all-54 skill map, profiles/mastery/cosmetics/remaps, all five modes and bank-safe consented secret extension remain implemented. Constable and Warden have two original-roster quality passes, 58 remain and zero human acceptances. Warden keeps actual rest-only patrol, locked sweep origins, alternating Brutal direction and fully warned sequential return with one active cone.

Protocol 20 migrates only known issued protocol 19 local Practice/profile revisions, preserving identity, money, discoveries and purchases; online/signed state stays strict. Validation: 484 automated tests, authored content/fifteen locales, TypeScript and production build pass. Fifteen new regressions cover all twelve phase/form combinations, all maps/difficulties, actual contact/emissions/weapon hits, linked cancellation, cleanup, motion/fallbacks, preserved scores, independent RGBA reconstruction, local migration and real owner/observer replication for all three Brutal encounters. Exact current logs, source/artifact hashes and failed attempts are retained under reviews/small-wakes-2026-10-26/.

The roster is 65 ordinary plus one secret; 85 more ordinary identities remain toward 150 ordinary plus secrets. Rendered animation, special-ability/boss art, native-language/listening/physical-device/final human balance, active mixed-progression/WAN/full endurance, hosted recovery/rankings and coordinated release gates remain open. Simultaneous boss pairs remain future encounter work.

Canonical Wiki has 18 pages/34 images, with exact committed publication/hash verification separate from source pushes. Every frozen preview is preserved. Public protocol-4 Site and immutable protocol-13 Windows development archive remain separate. No deployment, main merge, paid provisioning or contest submission is included.
